hypothesis.conditions: The program crashes with IndexError on the audited public input because the greedy loop pops from an empty heap: when processing m from n-1 down to 0, it requires bought >= m but the heap may not contain enough affordable voters at that point, so heapq.heappop raises IndexError.
hypothesis.expected_improvement: Replacing the empty-heap pop with a correct greedy that only buys when the heap is nonempty (or restructuring to guarantee enough candidates) should eliminate the IndexError and produce the expected outputs 8, 0, 7 on the public case.
hypothesis.refusal_conditions: Do not claim a certified root cause or hidden correctness; do not assert the fix is optimal beyond the public case; do not infer private test behavior.
hypothesis.stop_conditions: Stop after one bounded repair attempt if the public case still raises an exception or mismatches expected tokens; do not exceed remaining call budget.
hypothesis.unknowns: Whether the greedy ordering (processing m descending and buying cheapest available) is the correct algorithm for all inputs; whether additional edge cases (n=1, all m=0, large p) are handled; whether the heap can still be empty under a corrected loop.
